_about: Public-domain Patrick Hues Mell (1814-1888), Georgia Baptist minister, chancellor of the University of Georgia and president of the Southern Baptist Convention, for the Word Hoard: Baptism in its Modes and Subjects (1853), The Doctrine of Prayer (1876) and A Manual of Parliamentary Practice (1888), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 53 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mell-baptism: Baptism in its modes and subjects (Charleston : Southern Baptist Publication Society, 1853)
mell-prayer: The doctrine of prayer; its utility; and its relation to providence (New York, Sheldon & Company, 1876)

_excluded.mell-other: The botanical and agricultural works of his son P. H. Mell Jr. (another man); the Life of Patrick Hues Mell (1895, by his son)
_excluded.mell-parliamentary-practice: manualofparliame00mell: Mell's Manual of Parliamentary Practice is a procedure manual, not divinity; scan front matter is also unreadable OCR.
